body:
Server admin is reached from inside normal user settings on both clients: web SettingsPage.tsx:163
(a Link to /admin) and Android SettingsScreen.kt:91 (a Button), both shown only when the account is
an admin. It belongs beside Settings in the main menu instead — administering the server is not a
personal preference.

Both menus currently hold Overview, Join list, Settings, Log out: web AppShell.tsx's burger nav,
Android the ModalDrawerSheet's NavigationDrawerItem list in Nav.kt (~line 455). Add a "Server admin"
entry after Settings, shown only to an admin, and remove the entry from the settings screens. The
route stays as it is on both (/admin, Routes.ADMIN).

Web already has the flag in the shell: useAuth()'s account.isAdmin, and AppShell already reads
account.email. The Android drawer has no session state today; SessionStore.isAdmin exists (it is
what SettingsViewModel reads at line 102), so the drawer needs it wired through.

The existing label string (nav_server_admin / its web twin) is reused — no new string.
title: Server admin gets its own entry in the main menu, out of user settings
